system.name: Echo Descent
system.description: After the Tower unlock, five heroes face one daily Guardian fight under a randomly selected three-law theme and return with permanent Resonance.
system.mechanic_summary: One daily theme bundles three laws into a focused combat strategy.

daily_combinations.name: Arcane Famine
daily_combinations.description: Only Magic attacks deal damage. Mana is scarce, so debuffs create the safest openings.

daily_combinations.name: Bloodspell Crucible
daily_combinations.description: Only Magic attacks deal damage. Skills consume Health, while critical hits expose the Guardian.

daily_combinations.name: Silent Sanctum
daily_combinations.description: Only Magic attacks deal damage. Healing is weakened, and harmful effects become the main opening.

daily_combinations.name: Dry Powder
daily_combinations.description: Magic attacks deal no damage. Slower Mana gain shifts the plan toward physical critical hits.

daily_combinations.name: Bloodsteel Offensive
daily_combinations.description: Magic attacks deal no damage. Physical skills cost Health, and debuffs open burst windows.

daily_combinations.name: Mortal Vanguard
daily_combinations.description: Magic attacks deal no damage. Reduced healing rewards decisive physical critical chains.

daily_combinations.name: Prismatic Relay
daily_combinations.description: Repeated damage types are blocked. Rotate Melee, Ranged, and Magic attacks despite slower Mana gain.

daily_combinations.name: Sanguine Spectrum
daily_combinations.description: Repeated damage types are blocked. Rotate all three types while paying Health for active skills.

daily_combinations.name: Fractured Grace
daily_combinations.description: Repeated damage types are blocked. Rotate all three types while managing sharply reduced healing.

daily_combinations.name: Deadeye Drought
daily_combinations.description: Only Ranged attacks deal damage. Slower Mana gain rewards accurate critical volleys.

daily_combinations.name: Bloodshot Volley
daily_combinations.description: Only Ranged attacks deal damage. Skills cost Health, and debuffs open focused-fire windows.

daily_combinations.name: Last Arrow
daily_combinations.description: Only Ranged attacks deal damage. Reduced healing rewards decisive critical volleys.

mutations.name: Starved Current
mutations.description: Heroes gain 50% less Mana from their turns.

mutations.name: Sanguine Casting
mutations.description: Each hero active skill costs 8% of that hero's maximum Health after it resolves.

mutations.name: Severed Grace
mutations.description: All healing received by heroes is reduced by 40%.

mutations.name: Null Ward
mutations.description: Enemies are immune to Magic damage. Bring Melee or Ranged attackers.

mutations.name: Adamant Ward
mutations.description: Enemies are immune to Melee and Ranged damage. Bring Magic attackers.

mutations.name: Prismatic Memory
mutations.description: After an enemy takes a damage type, it is immune to that type until struck by a different one.

mutations.name: Horizon Ward
mutations.description: Enemies are immune to Melee and Magic damage. Bring Ranged attackers.

mutations.name: Triune Fracture
mutations.description: Attack an enemy with Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage to expose it to 30% more damage for the encounter.

mutations.name: Keen Rupture
mutations.description: A damaging critical hit exposes its target to 18% more damage for 2 turns.

mutations.name: Hexbreak
mutations.description: Applying a harmful effect exposes that enemy to 20% more damage for 2 turns.
